storage: Cut off any green tops, keep carrots in a bag or box in the fridge vegetable drawer; wash just before use.
looksLike: A tapering orange root, 10 to 20 cm long, with a smooth skin and a sweet, crunchy flesh. Ooty carrots are thicker and bright orange; red or desi winter carrots are a different, redder type.
howToPick: Firm, smooth, bright orange roots with no cracks, soft spots or hairy side roots. Avoid rubbery, bendy or sprouting carrots.
shelfLife: About 1 to 2 weeks in the fridge (general guidance; not from a source in this run).
mergeNotes: Range 45.6–116.6 was wider than 30% of avg 72.8; narrowed to ±15%.
